scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The exact reduction holds for non-lazy uniform Markovian \(n-1\)-subsets, all \(n\ge2\) and \(1\le s\le n-1\). Classical iid occupancy formulas are reused after a pathwise complement reduction. It does not prove the fixed-\(r\) conjecture, cover smaller \(r\), or establish priority over all older mathematical literature. Finite verifier cases supplement the analytic proof, and independent validation has not been performed.
title: Exact occupancy reduction for dense Markovian supercoupon collection
